claims.real_ui: QWidget tab with QFrame cards and QTableWidget reliability table
claims.calibration: Reads calibrated probability and validation state from CoinAnalysis
claims.drift: Reads Brier/ECE/PSI drift telemetry from CoinAnalysis
claims.order_flow: Reads runtime diagnostics and Position Building quality metadata
claims.evidence_reliability: Displays stored family summaries without reverse engineering
claims.observe_only: Does not modify confidence, status, sizing, risk, intent, or execution

limitations: Dashboard shows the selected or latest analysis only
Order-flow quality metadata is unavailable for legacy analyses without footprint metadata
No historical trend chart is included in this release
No automatic decision or execution changes are made
